final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.tradekind AS kind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS a FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS b FROM sentimentandfundamentals), s3 AS (SELECT s1.transref AS transref, s1.kind AS kind, s1.a AS a, s1.a - s2.b AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.b IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT kind, AVG(d) AS ad FROM s3 GROUP BY kind), s5 AS (SELECT s3.kind AS kind, s3.a AS a, s3.d AS d, s3.d - s4.ad AS e FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s3.kind = s4.kind WHERE s3.d > s4.ad) SELECT kind, AVG(a), AVG(d), AVG(e) FROM s5 GROUP BY kind
